root_idea.summary: The root develops along two closely related semantic orientations: support and accompanying alignment, and spreading or making something widely known.
root_idea.development: From support and following come meanings of aiding, accompanying, joining, and belonging to a party; from dissemination come meanings of publicizing, becoming widespread, dispersing, sharing in common, and kindling.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form شَاعَ rather than the attested imperfect تَشِيعَ.
Displayed under the singular nominal citation form شِيعَة.

senses.definition: To spread, become widely known, or become manifest.
senses.usage_conditions: An intransitive use in which information, a report, or another matter becomes public among people; the Quranic form is the active imperfect تَشِيعَ.

senses.definition: A party, faction, or group united by a common affair, affiliation, leader, or following; followers, assistants, or partisans.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun can denote a group or party in both singular and plural usage, including a group aligned with or following a particular person.

senses.definition: A group like another in kind, persuasion, or character; counterparts or people of the same sort.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially in plural constructions, it can refer to the likes of earlier peoples or to groups sharing the same persuasion or pattern.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become scattered or dispersed; to diffuse or spread through something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of milk dispersing in water, hoariness spreading through hair, a crack spreading in glass, or camels dispersing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow, accompany, or attend; to remain with or follow someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions such as wishing peace or prosperity to accompany and not leave someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fill a vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive usage with the vessel as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call or urge animals so that they follow one another; to blow a shepherd’s reed pipe for this purpose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a shepherd calling camels, sheep, or goats when some lag behind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send someone or something on, make it follow, or cause one thing to follow another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the construction of following one thing with another, as in following Ramadan with additional fasting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accompany someone on departure, bid farewell, or follow behind as a departing person or animal proceeds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of accompanying a guest or another departing person as a gesture of courtesy, and of following without catching up.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow, imitate, conform to, agree with, or comply with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational use involving conformity or imitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To encourage, embolden, or strengthen someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often used with an action or undertaking that the person is thereby strengthened to perform.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put slender firewood on a fire so as to make it blaze or burn more fiercely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative use applied to feeding and intensifying a fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To burn someone or something with fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle may describe something that has been burned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow or conform with someone in an affair or opinion, and to support or strengthen him in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an affair or opinion; the following may include agreement, compliance, and active support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To befriend someone or act as his ally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational use equivalent to showing friendship or allegiance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To call to a herd so that its members follow or find the way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of calling camels or directing a group by a signal or call.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spread, publish, divulge, reveal, or make known information, a report, a secret, or another matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative counterpart to becoming widespread or public.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disperse or distribute something among a people or group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of property or the contents of a cooking pot being distributed among people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, to eject urine in a scattered manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized camel-related usage, especially after mating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make peace, safety, or prosperity accompany and remain with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in formulas wishing safety or peace upon another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To profess adherence to the doctrine of the Shiʿa or to become a Shiʿi.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A sectarian doctrinal use derived from the specialized proper-name sense of الشِّيعَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strive or labor intensely for something out of love for it, even to the point of courting danger or death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with في in an intensive expression of devotion or exertion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be excited, unsettled, or flurried by anger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of anger causing lightness, levity, or unsteadiness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become separate parties or factions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or collective formation of distinct groups, derived from شِيعَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go or proceed together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective use describing people or animals moving together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The scattered urine of a camel after mating or sexual excitement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun used of camel urine that is ejected in dispersed drops.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A following interval or approximate span of time; the day or period immediately following another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions such as staying a month or its approximate duration, or coming tomorrow or the day after.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A successor or counterpart that follows another, or something like another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the one born next after another and, in another explanation, of a like or counterpart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A follower, friend, comrade, or assistant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for one who accompanies or supports another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lion’s cub, especially one that has begun to take prey; according to some, a lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological meaning with variation in the reported application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who follows after women and mixes, associates, or converses with them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic description of a person characterized by association with women.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explained as one who follows or conforms to her husband’s wishes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular low tree with jointed branches and small dark-red blossoms, used as pasture and valued for its fragrant, healthful properties.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical term for the plant and, by extension in the discussion, its blossom and honey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The later proper name for the sect that follows ʿAlī and the people of his household.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized sectarian use distinct from the general Quranic meaning of a party or faction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The doctrinal and practical system of the sect called الشِّيعَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the sect’s body of beliefs and practices.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shepherd’s reed pipe, or the sound of that pipe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The instrument is used to call together or direct camels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Callers or summoners.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural-like noun associated with calling or summoning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Slender firewood that quickly catches and makes a fire blaze.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of fuel that prevails over larger or thicker firewood once kindled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sharer or partner; something shared or held jointly and undivided.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of partners in a house or land and of property held in common.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Spreading, widely known, published, or manifest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of information, news, or tidings becoming known among people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Scattered, dispersed, or in a state of dispersion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived adjectival use applied to people or things distributed apart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An undivided lot, share, or portion held in common.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a share that has not been separated or partitioned from the whole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A supplement, addition, or augment to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal extension for something added to or accompanying another thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Filled, especially filled to capacity when said of a vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a vessel or container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Very rancorous, malicious, spiteful, or filled with baseness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival use derived from the notion of being filled, sometimes applied to a person by comparison with a particularly rancorous lizard.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm-leaf basket or container in which a woman keeps cotton and other belongings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Named in relation to its accompanying or following its owner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who cannot keep or conceal a secret; a babbler of news.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A person characterized by readily divulging information.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Courageous, emboldened, or strengthened in resolve.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explained as if encouraged by another, by inner strength, or by undertaking formidable affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Very quick, speedy, or hasty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use applied to a person or thing characterized by speed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sheep or goat that follows behind the others or must be urged on to follow them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a weak or lean sacrificial animal that lags behind the flock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Overtaking or catching up with another; one who overtakes or comes up with others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of one who gathers up those proceeding behind the rest.

cautions: The Quranic plural usage corresponding to أَشْيَاع can mean counterparts or peoples of the same persuasion, not only sects in the modern sense.

Three Lane passages remain unresolved because their readings or interpretations are explicitly disputed: the reported intercourse-related use of الشِّيَاع, the reported Form IV meaning of خروج, and the reported Form V meaning of leaving part of something undistributed.
